tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the CWI placement catalog (That Boy Hi Hat + roster) by keywords. Same scored engine as GET /query: title matches weigh 3x, genre 2x, mood 1x. Returns top 5 tracks with Spotify URLs and matched terms.

tools.name: get_track
tools.description: Look up one catalog track by title or Spotify ID/URL. Returns title, artist, Spotify URL, genres, and moods.

tools.name: get_artist
tools.description: Look up an artist by name. Returns the artist and their tracks in the catalog with Spotify URLs.

tools.name: sync_search
tools.description: Search the CWI sync catalog (23 tracks with editorial sonic descriptors: moods, energy words, instrumentation, scenes, use-cases, lyrical themes) for music-supervision queries like "fight scene" or "neon city". Descriptors are editorial (curated by CWI Sync); BPM values are estimates, not audio anal

tools.name: semantic_search
tools.description: Semantic search over the CWI catalog embedding matrix: cosine similarity against 384-dim bge-small-en-v1.5 vectors (55 tracks). The query is embedded at request time with Workers AI @cf/baai/bge-small-en-v1.5 — the same model that produced the matrix, so catalog and query vectors are directly cosine

tools.name: get_graph
tools.description: Summarize the CWI catalog knowledge graph (node/edge counts, types, sample nodes). For the full graph, fetch GET /graph.json.

tools.name: get_release
tools.description: Fetch a CWI release fact packet (evidence-tiered, hash-stamped): pre-release and release records with verified credits, dates, and platform links. Defaults to the latest release when id is omitted.
